description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Competitive Data Scientist (Kaggle) - AI Training & Evaluation based in the United States. 

 We are seeking highly accomplished Data Scientists, Machine Learning Practitioners, and Applied Mathematics Experts with proven experience in competitive data science, particularly through Kaggle and similar competition platforms. In this role, you will leverage your programming expertise, statistical knowledge, and analytical reasoning to design challenging technical tasks for advanced AI training and evaluation. You will develop reproducible computational environments, implement verified reference solutions, and create robust evaluation frameworks to assess AI-generated outputs. Your work will help distinguish genuine technical understanding from solutions that are incomplete, inaccurate, or methodologically flawed. You will also test and analyze coding agents, identify weaknesses, and refine evaluation tasks to improve AI problem-solving capabilities. This fully remote opportunity offers flexible working hours and the chance to apply your competitive data science expertise to cutting-edge AI development.



Accountabilities:
 

 Design challenging data science, machine learning, and applied mathematics tasks that require advanced analytical reasoning and practical programming skills.

 Build reproducible computational environments, prepare relevant datasets, configure dependencies, and implement reliable reference solutions.

 Develop comprehensive test cases, evaluation criteria, and verification mechanisms to distinguish technically correct solutions from incomplete, inaccurate, or flawed implementations.

 Execute coding agents against assigned technical challenges, analyze their outputs, investigate failures, and refine tasks based on observed performance.

 Identify implementation errors, incorrect assumptions, data leakage, methodological weaknesses, and other issues that could compromise solution accuracy or reliability.

 Validate proposed solutions through independent testing, computational experiments, debugging, and reproducible workflows.

 Evaluate machine learning approaches, algorithms, statistical methodologies, and implementation decisions for technical correctness and effectiveness.

 Document task requirements, solution methodologies, technical reasoning, and verification procedures in a clear and structured manner.

 Navigate existing codebases and computational workflows to investigate technical issues and implement effective solutions.

 Ensure all assigned tasks, evaluation frameworks, and reference solutions meet high standards of accuracy, reliability, completeness, and reproducibility.


 Requirements:


 Expert rank or higher on Kaggle or an equivalent competitive data science platform.

 Demonstrated experience participating in competitive data science, machine learning, or applied mathematics competitions.

 Strong understanding of data science methodologies, machine learning algorithms, statistical analysis, and mathematical problem-solving.

 Practical programming proficiency, particularly in Python, with the ability to independently develop, implement, test, debug, and validate complex solutions.

 Ability to clearly explain the reasoning behind selected approaches, algorithms, statistical methods, and implementation decisions.

 Experience building reproducible computational workflows and evaluating technical solutions against predefined performance and correctness criteria.

 Strong analytical thinking, debugging capabilities, and attention to detail, particularly when identifying subtle implementation errors and methodological weaknesses.

 Hands-on experience navigating unfamiliar codebases, understanding existing workflows, and implementing solutions efficiently.

 Familiarity with Python-based data science and machine learning libraries and tools.

 Understanding of automated evaluation, benchmarking methodologies, testing frameworks, and reproducibility practices.

 Experience working with coding agents or AI-assisted development tools is an advantage.

 Relevant experience with one or more competitive platforms, including Kaggle, DrivenData, Zindi, AIcrowd, Numerai, DataSource.ai, or CodaLab/Codabench.

 Ability to work independently, manage technical challenges, and deliver well-documented, reliable solutions within defined project requirements.


 Benefits:


 Competitive compensation: $60–$120 per hour, depending on expertise and successful task completion.

 Flexible workload: Approximately 15 hours per week, allowing you to organize your schedule around your professional commitments.

 Flexible working hours: Choose your preferred working days and hours, including weekends.

 Fully remote opportunity: Work remotely from anywhere within the eligible location.

 Independent contractor engagement: Flexible professional collaboration without a traditional full-time employment commitment.

 Advanced AI projects: Contribute to cutting-edge AI training and evaluation initiatives involving machine learning, competitive programming, statistics, and applied mathematics.

 Meaningful technical impact: Help improve the reasoning, coding capabilities, and problem-solving performance of advanced AI systems.

 Competitive data science exposure: Apply your competition experience and technical expertise to challenging real-world AI evaluation scenarios.

 Independent problem-solving: Take ownership of technical tasks, develop innovative solutions, and apply your preferred computational methodologies.

 Professional flexibility: Combine project-based technical work with other professional or research activities.
